faq.q: How do I find my zodiac sign?
faq.a: Your zodiac (sun) sign depends on the date you were born. Enter your birth month and day above and the calculator shows your sign, element and ruling planet.

faq.q: What if I was born on the cusp?
faq.a: If you were born within a day or two of a sign change, the exact time and place of birth decide your sun sign. Use a birth chart calculator with your birth time to be sure.

faq.q: Are sun signs the same in the southern hemisphere?
faq.a: Yes. Western astrology uses the same dates for the zodiac signs everywhere in the world.

moon-sign.title: Moon Sign Calculator – Find Your Moon Sign Free
moon-sign.description: Free moon sign calculator. Enter your birth date, time and timezone to find which zodiac sign your Moon was in, calculated from astronomical data.
moon-sign.lead: Find the zodiac sign your Moon was in at the moment you were born.
moon-sign.resultText: Your Moon was at about {degrees}° {sign}. {element} moon, {modality} energy. Emotionally you tend to be {keywords}.
moon-sign.aboutText: While your sun sign describes your core identity, your moon sign describes your inner world: how you process feelings, what comforts you and how you react when you are not performing for anyone. Two people with the same sun sign can feel very different if their moon signs differ.

faq.a: Your moon sign is the zodiac sign the Moon was in when you were born. It is associated with emotions, instincts and what makes you feel secure.

faq.q: Do I need my exact birth time?
faq.a: The Moon changes sign roughly every two and a half days, so the date is often enough. If you were born on a day the Moon changed sign, the time matters.
It uses astronomical ephemeris calculations of the Moon's ecliptic longitude, the same data used by professional astrology software.
It is the time difference between your birth place and UTC at that moment. For example New York is UTC−5 in winter and UTC−4 in summer, London is UTC+0 in winter and UTC+1 in summer.

life-path.lead: Your life path number is calculated from your full date of birth.

faq.q: How do you calculate a life path number?
faq.a: Reduce the birth year, month and day separately to single digits, add them together and reduce again. The numbers 11, 22 and 33 are master numbers and are not reduced further.
Master numbers 11, 22 and 33 are considered to carry a stronger potential and a stronger challenge than their single-digit versions.
No. Numerology is a belief system used for reflection and entertainment, not a predictive science.

chinese-zodiac.title: Chinese Zodiac Calculator – Find Your Animal and Element
chinese-zodiac.description: Free Chinese zodiac calculator. Enter your birth date to find your animal sign and element, with the correct Lunar New Year cutoff.
chinese-zodiac.lead: Find your Chinese zodiac animal and element from your birth date.
chinese-zodiac.resultYearBefore: You were born before Lunar New Year in {birthYear}, so your Chinese zodiac year is {year}.
chinese-zodiac.animalsText: The animal cycle repeats every 12 years and combines with five elements for a 60-year cycle. The year changes at Lunar New Year, not on January 1.

faq.q: Why is my Chinese zodiac animal different from my birth year?
faq.a: The Chinese zodiac year starts on Lunar New Year, which falls between late January and mid February. If you were born before it, your animal is the one from the previous year.

faq.q: What is the Chinese zodiac element?
faq.a: Each year also has one of five elements: Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water. Each element lasts two years, which gives a 60-year cycle.

1.title: The Leader
1.text: Independent, driven and original. Life path 1 people start things, trust their own judgement and learn to balance self-reliance with cooperation.

2.title: The Peacemaker
2.text: Sensitive, diplomatic and attuned to others. Life path 2 thrives in partnership and learns to speak up for its own needs.

3.title: The Communicator
3.text: Expressive, creative and sociable. Life path 3 brings joy and ideas, and learns to focus its many talents.

4.title: The Builder
4.text: Practical, disciplined and dependable. Life path 4 builds lasting foundations and learns to stay flexible.

5.title: The Adventurer
5.text: Freedom-loving, curious and adaptable. Life path 5 craves variety and learns commitment without feeling caged.

6.title: The Nurturer
6.text: Caring, responsible and community-minded. Life path 6 looks after others and learns not to carry everyone's burdens.

7.title: The Seeker
7.text: Analytical, introspective and spiritual. Life path 7 searches for truth and learns to trust and connect.

8.title: The Powerhouse
8.text: Ambitious, strategic and results-oriented. Life path 8 is drawn to achievement and learns to balance success with values.

9.title: The Humanitarian
9.text: Compassionate, idealistic and generous. Life path 9 serves a bigger picture and learns to let go.

11.title: The Visionary (master number)
11.text: Intuitive, inspiring and highly sensitive. Life path 11 carries a strong inner vision and learns to ground it in daily life.

22.title: The Master Builder (master number)
22.text: Practical visionary with the potential to turn big dreams into reality, and the pressure that comes with it.

33.title: The Master Teacher (master number)
33.text: Selfless, healing and devoted to uplifting others. Life path 33 learns to care for itself while serving.

faq.q: Does compatibility depend only on sun signs?
faq.a: No. Moon sign, Venus sign and the full birth charts add a lot of nuance. Sun sign compatibility is a fun starting point rather than a verdict.

elementPairs.fire-fire: Two fire signs create heat and excitement fast. Both are passionate and confident, so the relationship runs on energy, but neither likes to back down.
elementPairs.earth-earth: Two earth signs build something solid. Shared practicality and loyalty make for a stable, comfortable bond, with the risk of getting stuck in routine.
elementPairs.air-air: Two air signs share a mental spark. Conversation never runs dry, but emotional follow-through takes conscious effort.
elementPairs.water-water: Two water signs feel each other deeply, often without words. The connection is intense and tender, and moods can amplify each other.
elementPairs.air-fire: Air feeds fire. This is one of the most naturally energising pairings: ideas, adventure and enthusiasm flow in both directions.
elementPairs.earth-water: Water nourishes earth. Emotional depth meets steadiness, a supportive and growth-oriented match.
elementPairs.earth-fire: Fire wants to move and earth wants to build. They can balance each other, but pace and priorities need negotiation.
elementPairs.air-earth: Air lives in ideas and earth in the concrete. The two see the world differently, which can feel either refreshing or frustrating.
elementPairs.fire-water: Fire and water are opposites in temperament: direct versus sensitive. The chemistry is real, but it needs patience and care to avoid steam.
elementPairs.air-water: Air reasons while water feels. They can learn a lot from each other if they translate between logic and emotion.

modalityPairs.cardinal-cardinal: Both are initiators, so there is drive and no shortage of plans, along with occasional contests over who leads.
modalityPairs.fixed-fixed: Both are loyal and determined. That brings staying power, and also stubbornness when they disagree.
modalityPairs.mutable-mutable: Both are flexible and adaptable. Easy to be around, though decisions and follow-through can drift.
modalityPairs.cardinal-fixed: One starts things and the other sustains them, a practical division of roles when respected.
modalityPairs.cardinal-mutable: The initiator and the adapter tend to fit well: one sets direction and the other adjusts smoothly.
modalityPairs.fixed-mutable: The steady one anchors and the flexible one softens. Works well as long as the fixed sign does not take flexibility for granted.
